title: Plyometric Push-Up
summary: An explosive push-up where your hands leave the floor. It's for upper-body power, not size.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.55 for chest (helper): each working set adds 0.55 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.4 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.35 for front delts (minor): each working set adds 0.35 of a set to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Lower, then push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly and go into the next rep.

form_cues.cue: Push explosively so hands leave the floor

mistakes.text: Letting the hips sag on landing.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, More technical.
